entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Three goblin raiders
entries.text:
Three Goblin raiders burst from cover at the Raided Waystation and close in. They haven't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the goblin raiders.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Three goblin raiders
story.premise: A combat test: three goblin raiders ambush Kara Vell at the Raided Waystation while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: Three Goblin raiders burst from cover at the Raided Waystation and close in. They haven't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the goblin raiders.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.

story.foeAppearance: A wiry green-grey goblin with oversized ears, a jagged grin and a helmet made from a dented cooking pot. It carries a chipped short blade and a rope belt hung with stolen trinkets.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Raided Waystation
bridge.description: A burned-out waystation with a smashed well cover and scattered supply crates.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.
